years old P3L3 female, agricultural labourer by occupation, came to the casuality with C\/O generalised weakness since 2 days"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cdiv\u003E45 years old P3L3 female, agricultural labourer by occupation, came to the casuality with C\/O generalised weakness since 2 days.\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/O vomitings and loose stools 2 days back.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHOPI:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 1 year back and then had H\/O Neck pain and backache - dragging type of pain, not associated with any numbness, tingling sensation of upper and lower limbs.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient started taking NSAID daily once for pain for 1 month, then she visited orthopaedician and advised her to get MRI: L-Spine and after that she was advised for surgery.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient had difficulty in passing stools (constipation) since 1 month for which the patient went to the nearby doctor 2 days back.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe was put on Syp. Lactulose and after 1 day, the patient had 5 episodes of watery stools for 1 day, 2 episodes of vomitings for 1 day which subsided now.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGeneralised weakness present since 2 days.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPAST HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot a K\/C\/O DM\/HTN\/BA\/TB\/Epilepsy\/Thyroid disorders\/CAD\/CVA\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient underwent ECSL for Right Renal stones (ECSL) 6 years back, Hysterectomy 20 yrs back and Left Cataract Surgery 6 yrs back.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet- mixed\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite- Normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESleep- Adequate\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel and bladder movements- Regular\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo known allergies\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo addictions\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFamily history: not significant\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient is Conscious, coherent, cooperative.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo Pallor, icterus, cyanosis, clubbing, koilonychia, lymphadenopathy, edema.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
